secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app id (from the Base44 Builder app settings). Sent as the X-App-Id header on backend calls.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base44 hosted backend URL. The vite plugin proxies /api -> this URL so the SPA can reach the backend. Without it the app renders but loads no data.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION
secrets.description: Base44 backend functions version (from the Base44 Builder).

secrets.name: VITE_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key (pk_...) for the Paystack checkout integration. Only needed for payment screens.

secrets.name: VITE_PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: PayPal client id for the Shanana checkout. Only needed for the PayPal payment screen.
